VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CULTIVATE.title: Cultivate
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CULTIVATE.description: Put the chosen card in your Cultivate Pile. Its countdown is its base cost, with a minimum of 1 turn and a maximum of 3 (X counts as 1). At the start of your turn, reduce the countdown by 1. Harvest the card when it reaches 0.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_PERMANENT_CULTIVATE.desc: When Cultivated, this card stays in your Cultivate Pile and triggers its listed effect there. It has no countdown and cannot be Harvested. Playing it does not Cultivate it.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_WITHER.title: Wither
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_WITHER.description: Remove the specified card from your Cultivate Pile for the rest of combat without Harvesting it.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_VIEWER_COUNT.title: Viewer
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_VIEWER_COUNT.description: A counter. Whenever you play a card during your turn, gain 1 Viewer. Viewers reset to 0 at the end of your turn.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_KAOZI.title: Kaozi
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_KAOZI.description: At the start of your turn, gain Viewer equal to your Kaozi stacks.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_ANTI_STOMP.title: Anti-Stomp
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_ANTI_STOMP.description: The first X cards you play each turn do not grant Viewer.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CHUANZI.title: Troll
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_CHUANZI.description: At the start of your turn, gain X random stacks of Vigor or Stretch.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_FARMER_FORM.title: Farmer Form
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_FARMER_FORM.description: At the start of your turn, reduce all countdowns in your Cultivate Pile by 1 more per stack. Each time a countdown reaches 0, Harvest 1 additional card per stack.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_GROW.title: Grow
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_GROW.description: Reduce all countdowns in your Cultivate Pile by the listed number of turns. Immediately Harvest cards that reach 0.
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_HARVEST.title: Harvest
VIRIDIS_KEYWORD_HARVEST.description:
Add a new card to your Hand, or to your Discard Pile if your Hand is full. It is usually one rarity higher and inherits the original card’s upgrade. An Ancient yields 2 cards of the same name instead.
If the original card’s base cost was 2 or higher, each harvested card costs at most 1 Energy the first time you play it.
VIRIDIS_CULTIVATE_PILE.title: Cultivate Pile
